outcomes.requirement: Remember a successful Biz pull across admin reloads.
outcomes.evidence: Aggregate snapshots are stored in vii_biz_conversion_snapshots_v1 by world, supplier business and exact date range, and the report GET returns matching saved snapshots.

outcomes.requirement: Do not recalculate every business on an identical reload.
outcomes.evidence: The cache test proves one supplier call for the first pull and zero additional supplier calls for the second identical fresh pull.

outcomes.requirement: Keep the last result when Biz is temporarily unavailable.
outcomes.evidence: A forced refresh failure returns the last good aggregate with stale_fallback status and does not overwrite the saved payload.

outcomes.requirement: Avoid unnecessary retention of supplier contact details.
outcomes.evidence: The persistence layer deletes contacts before serialization; tests verify the restored aggregate has no contacts field.
